paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of and by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the “effect” values, along with standard deviation error bars, for various multilingual BERT models across different language families. The horizontal axis represents language families, listed alphabetically from “IE-Baltic” to “Uralic,” and the vertical axis represents “effect,” ranging from approximately 0 to 40, using a linear scale. The scale is marked with tick labels every 5 units, and the units are not explicitly stated, though are assumed to be a standardized effect value. Each bar represents a specific BERT model variant: “mBERT-targ” (blue), “XLM-targ” (dark blue), “mBERT-permute” (red), “mBERT-mute” (light red), “XLM-permute” (green), and “IE-Romance” (light green).  The tallest bar, representing “XLM-targ”, reaches approximately 36, with the shortest bar, “IE-Romance”, reaching approximately 12.  Error bars are consistently present for each bar, with values ranging from approximately 3 to 8.  The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
